_comment: Curated Whitaker-style lexicon. Each entry is a lemma + stem(s); morphology.py generates all regular forms from the stem, the way Whitaker's WORDS does with STEMLIST + INFLECTS. Irregular forms are listed explicitly and always win over generated forms. Drop a Whitaker DICTLINE-style file in data/whitaker/ and see docs/whitaker.md for the loader contract.
